title: Desktop shell is lifecycle only
summary: WireSwingDesktopWindow provides a real JFrame host while keeping journey/business authority in the Wire stack. It attaches the runtime stable host once, owns show/hide/dispose/title/size/capture lifecycle, and does not interpret semantic transitions.
invariants: Use DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE rather than terminating the JVM.
A stable renderer host prevents snapshot replacement from invalidating the JFrame attachment.
Window close may signal a narrow lifecycle callback for host cleanup but cannot alter Wire journey state.
The standalone executable demo may contain a separate demo authority, but WireSwingRuntime itself remains passive.

provenance.claim: Qualified desktop shell lifecycle and JFrame encapsulation.
